title: Coldcard probes phishing post on its X account after July exploit
description: Coldcard said an unauthorized phishing link appeared on its official X account on Oct. 11 and asked X to investigate, months after a $100 million-plus exploit of its wallets.

title: Ledger confirms hardware implant in reseller device as losses may top $86M
description: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device sold by reseller CryptoBilis, with investigator estimates putting losses above $86 million, while PeckShield traced $3.89 million to Binance deposits.

title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could have minted trillions
description: Developers disclosed a payment-engine overflow that could have created 18 trillion XRP in one transaction, found by Veria AI and patched in xrpld 3.4.1 after bypassing the normal validator vote.

title: Abstract shuts down Ethereum layer 2, sets Dec. 15 deadline
description: Igloo Inc. said its Abstract network will go dark on Dec. 15 after two years without product-market fit, telling users to bridge funds off before then.

title: UK names six banks to lead first digital gilt pilot
description: HM Treasury appointed Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, Morgan Stanley, NatWest and RBC Capital Markets as joint lead managers for the DIGIT pilot, expected by early 2027.
